newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's KOCOPIA passes on 52,500T corn tender.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's KOCOPIA passes on 52,500T corn tender.

text.p: South Korea's Korea Corn Processing Industry Association (KOCOPIA) said on Friday it passed on tenders for 52,500 tonnes of U.S. No.2 yellow corn.
Officials at the KOCOPIA did not elaborate on why they passed on the tender.
Traders said the lowest bid was made by Japanese trading house Mitsui and Co Ltd at $129.85 a tonne, FOB, or $144.05 a tonne, C&F.
Shipment for the passed tender was scheduled for November 11-30 from the Pacific Northwest or October 25-November 15 if from the U.S. Gulf.
Arrival was set for the western port city of Inchon.
